LESSON: DRAWING MAKING TECHNIQUES

Grade: PP1
Subject: PSYCHOMOTOR AND CREATIVE ACTIVITIES
Strand: PICTURE
Topic 1.1: Drawing MAKING TECHNIQUES

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Drawing MAKING TECHNIQUES. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Drawing MAKING TECHNIQUES in the examples.
